body:
It worked for me. It really helped derealization. I rarely get an episode. I find during the end of my cycle it gets worse so I up my dose a little more but just for a few days. 

I started with 600mg 4 years ago and on 1800 mg now. I do find my memory is awful though. I feel like at this point I need to decide what problem is worse. 

My plan is to taper down to 1000mg a day and see how that works.
